summary: A Lexis+ Word download often puts a reporter page marker in a paragraph by itself; the reader must count that marker as a page break even though the paragraph has no words.
reason: Dropping word-less paragraphs lost those markers, so citecheck reported passages one page early and flagged correct pin cites as wrong.
validated_outcome: On a 27-case brief, three pins first reported as wrong (Elmi, Payne, Machado) matched once the markers were kept.
